suggestions.rationale: Mapping Expansion Batch ME-10 adds this relationship only as a bounded clinical proposition. Hypertension is among the cardiometabolic comorbidities reported in narcolepsy, with greater cardiometabolic burden particularly in narcolepsy type 1; this supports association and screening relevance only. Require separately diagnosed hypertension. Preserve obesity, obstructive sleep apnea, metabolic syndrome, stimulant or other medication exposure, age, sex, renal or endocrine causes, and other conventional hypertension risk factors. Do not state or imply individual causation from the meta-analysis alone. The cited literature supports only this constrained relationship and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
